title: Crab Rangoon Dip
description: A delicious dip inspired by crab rangoons, perfect for parties and football season.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Mix until well blended and smooth.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
notes:
Serve chilled with crackers or vegetable sticks.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/18s4emmBmm/

Nutrition: Serving 1/8 of dip · Calories 150 kcal · Fat 12 g · Saturated fat 6 g · Unsaturated fat 6 g · Trans fat 0 g · Cholesterol 30 mg · Sodium 300 mg · Carbs 8 g · Fiber 1 g · Sugar 2 g · Protein 6 g

healthy: Green onions add a little vegetable.
not_healthy: Cream cheese and sour cream make it high in saturated fat.
Soy sauce, Worcestershire and seasoning add sodium.
Usually eaten with chips or crackers.
